name: Halaan Hawk-Eye
summary: From Thendal Village, Halaan Hawk-Eye watches Zephras Isle’s anchor pylons. Though he lacks many Skyborne gifts, his keen natural vision helps him warn visitors as the pylons’ magic falters.

sections.title: A Watchman Without Magic
sections.body: From the tower above Thendal Village, Halaan Hawk-Eye keeps watch. Many Skyborne can draw on the ley lines beneath Zephras Isle or see between worlds with mystical skysight. Halaan has neither gift. So he trusts his sharp natural senses, scanning the horizon for the island’s anchor pylons and calling attention to their increasingly volatile, inconsistent arcane energies.

faq.answer: Halaan Hawk-Eye watches from the tower above Thendal Village on Zephras Isle. He scans the surrounding land and warns visitors about the erratic magic afflicting the island’s anchor pylons.

faq.q: What makes Halaan different from other Skyborne?
faq.answer: Unlike many Skyborne, Halaan cannot see between worlds with mystical skysight or harness the ley lines beneath Zephras Isle. He relies on keen eyesight and natural observation.

faq.q: Why is Halaan worried about the anchor pylons?
aliases: what is wrong with the pylons
faq.answer: Halaan has noticed the distant anchor pylons’ magic growing erratic and inconsistent. He does not know how this threatens Zephras Isle’s stability.

faq.q: Where can I find Halaan Hawk-Eye?
faq.answer: You can find Halaan Hawk-Eye atop the wooden watchtower in Thendal Village on Zephras Isle. He looks out over the horizon.

angles.text: As a Skyborne, you can see how those without a natural affinity for ley line magic or skysight still serve their community through vigilance and martial duty.
